360:t_018:10.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Consider it my thanks. I'll eliminate your enemies.」

360:t_018:11.en:
$$アスカ$$
「He...! Is he looking this way?!」

360:t_019:3.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Brat $$シンジ$$! Who asked you to shield me?!」

360:t_019:6.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I can't stand... seeing anyone else get hurt...!」

360:t_019:8.en:
$$カヲル$$
「...This is what the Lilin are. Though you'd scorn them as Wingless.」

360:t_019:9.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It's foolish. I can't understand it.」

360:t_019:11.en:
$$アマタ$$
「We won't let you use the $$神話型アクエリオン$$ for your ambitions!!」

360:t_019:12.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「...There's no need to hurry, winged dog and Wingless one. The day of harvest is still to come.」

360:t_019:13.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Struggle until then. Use every bit of your paltry strength.」

360:t_020:0.en:
$$アンディ$$
「That bastard! He ran off after all that big talk?!」

360:t_020:1.en:
$$モロイ$$
「But he spoke as though he was waiting for an opportunity.」

360:t_020:2.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「I-is this okay?! If the $$神話型アクエリオン$$'s been stolen, won't the world's balance be thrown off again...?!」

360:t_020:3.en:
$$カヲル$$
「There's no need to worry. The world's balance is being maintained.」

360:t_020:7.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Oh, come on! Think about whether this is the time for that!」

360:t_020:9.en:
$$アスカ$$
「There are still enemies left, Brat $$シンジ$$! If you're going to talk big, hurry up and take them out!」

360:t_020:11.en:
$n
「Has $$シンジ$$ found something to believe in?」

360:t_020:13.en:
$$赤木$$
「Let's go, $$シンジ$$! You have the power to protect someone!」

360:t_020:15.en:
$$カヲル$$
「You can do it. I'm here to help you.」

360:t_020:17.en:
$$カヲル$$
(And $$シンジ$$... I'll protect you...)

360:t_021:0.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Have we taken care of all the enemies?」

360:t_021:1.en:
$$アレク$$
「$$ギルボア$$ reports he's finished clearing the surrounding area, too.」

360:t_021:2.en:
$$フラスト$$
「I'd heard about it, but $c really has been fighting monsters like those...」

360:t_021:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「Well done, $$ガランシェール$$ team. Dock with the $$宇宙航行母艦ソレスタルビーイング$$, too.」

360:t_021:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$シンジ$$, $$アスカ$$, and the others have gotten a little of their old rhythm back, too.」

360:t_021:7.en:
$n
「I hope things take a turn for the better now.」

360:t_021:8.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Now the problem is $$ミカゲ$$...」

360:t_021:9.en:
$$アルト$$
(What's this day of harvest he mentioned...? Are $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$ involved, too...?)

360:t_022:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Damn it...! Don't think this is all I'm capable of!」

360:t_023:1.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「He... doesn't even know what he's fighting for anymore...」

360:t_024:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You're persistent, $$カミーユ$$! Leave me alone!」

360:t_024:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You can say that once you stop coming after me!」

360:t_024:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't fight over a personal grudge, $$ギュネイ$$! Is that all you amount to?!」

360:t_024:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If you won't stop fighting, I have no choice but to fight back!」

360:t_025:0.en:
$$クェス$$
「Stop it, $$ギュネイ$$! Come with us!」

360:t_025:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「...There's something I have to do! I can't join you until I've done it!」

360:t_025:2.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Don't you realize how much you're hurting $$クェス$$ with your selfish behavior?!」

360:t_025:4.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「No, I'm going to say it! If you make $$クェス$$ suffer any more, I'll defeat you myself!」

360:t_025:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「That boy...! What is he doing?!」

360:t_025:7.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Is that okay, $$クェス$$?」

360:t_025:9.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Damn it... damn it!! What... am I doing?!」

360:t_026:0.en:
$$クェス$$
「Stop it, $$ギュネイ$$! Come with us!」

360:t_026:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「...There's something I have to do! I can't join you until I've done it!」

360:t_026:2.en:
$$クェス$$
「You stubborn fool! Is surpassing the Colonel and $$カミーユ$$ really that important?!」

360:t_026:3.en:
$$クェス$$
「Then I'll show you myself! You can't beat those two!」

360:t_026:6.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Damn it... damn it!! What... am I doing?!」

360:t_027:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$ギュネイ$$! Don't choose the wrong path!」

360:t_027:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You're one to talk, Colonel!」

360:t_027:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「...That's true... It seems my words can't stop you.」

360:t_027:3.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Then what will you do?」

360:t_027:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「I'll do what an adult should, and teach a young man how powerless he is!」

360:t_027:5.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Fine by me! Then I'll use my strength to get rid of an old man!」

360:t_028:0.en:
$$フラスト$$
「Even this $$ガランシェール$$ can get the job done if we try.」
